text: Infrastructure can be written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, YAML, or HCL, with each language equally capable across all Registry providers

text: Supports unit tests with mocked calls, property tests during deployment, and integration tests against ephemeral infrastructure
